compression: gzip and lossless shared JSON blocks; every original passport round-trip verified
report_delivery: HTML generated from precomputed passports and downloaded locally

calculation_revision.execution_context: Parallel batch precomputation with equivalent read-only and solver caches. Run durations describe this batch, not a cold-start performance benchmark. Identical input envelopes may share storage while retaining individual UUID paths and native SHA256 checks.

export_cache_validation.scope: Ryazan extended expansion N=11..15; native exact-size cache keys preserved

calculation_revision.interpretation: Current algorithm reruns using exact stored requests; differences are not an isolated RNPK causal experiment.
calculation_revision.population_consistency_policy: Baseline + gain equals covered within 0.01; covered + remaining equals raster total within 0.5 person per selected point + 0.01, because native point gains are rounded to whole persons
calculation_revision.position_comparison_policy: Sorted exact WGS84 coordinate sets; ignore ranking and cell identifiers

local_road_proxy_extension.interpretation: User-approved geometric OSM screening extension; no measured traffic or pollutant concentration
